class.name: OcgXcafdocMaterialtool
class.brief_description: Provides tools to store and retrieve attributes (materials) of TopoDS_Shape in and from TDocStd_Document A Document is intended to hold different attributes of ONE shape and it's sub-shapes Provide tools for management of Materialss section of document.
class.description: ! Provides tools to store and retrieve attributes (materials) ! of TopoDS_Shape in and from TDocStd_Document ! A Document is intended to hold different ! attributes of ONE shape and it's sub-shapes ! Provide tools for management of Materialss section of document.

method.name: BaseLabel
method.description: returns the label under which colors are stored

method.name: IsMaterial
method.description: Returns True if label belongs to a material table and is a Material definition

method.name: GetMaterialLabels
method.description: Returns a sequence of materials currently stored in the material table

method.name: AddMaterial
method.description: Adds a Material definition to a table and returns its label

method.name: SetMaterial_2
method.description: Sets a link with GUID Adds a Material as necessary

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: GetMaterial
method.description: Returns Material assigned to <MatL> Returns False if no such Material is assigned

method.name: GetDensityForShape
method.description: Find referred material and return density from it if no material --> return 0
